concerns.text: Task T016 implements a *stratified* 80/20 split, explicitly replacing the original “disjoint elemental sets” requirement. The specification (spec.md) and plan (plan.md) do not currently reflect this change, so the task weakens the original constraint without an updated FR/SC. This constitutes retroactive narrowing and violates constraint preservation.

Task T048 (update spec.md to replace “disjoint elemental sets” with “Stratified by Elemental Ratios”) is still unchecked. Until this update is performed, the spec remains out‑of‑sync with the implemented split in T016, leaving a permanent mismatch that weakens the project's functional requirements.

Task T049 (update plan.md to remove adaptive permutation‑count logic) is unchecked. The plan still mentions adaptive logic, while tasks T044‑T050 assume a fixed 1 000 permutations per FR‑006. This discrepancy weakens the specification of permutation testing.

Task T050 (add note to spec.md clarifying that adaptive permutation count is not permitted) remains undone, so the spec’s “Assumptions” section does not explicitly document the fixed‑permutation requirement that tasks rely on, creating an undocumented weakening of FR‑006.
